# Colour palettes (ColorHunt)

Source: colorhunt.co popular and new feeds, pulled 2026-10-01. **4255 palettes**, each 4 colours, 31 themes.
Full data: `vision/masters/palettes.json` — one object per line, sorted by likes:

```json
{"id":"e3fdfdcbf1f5a6e3e971c9ce","hex":["#E3FDFD","#CBF1F5","#A6E3E9","#71C9CE"],"rgb":[[227,253,253],[203,241,245],[166,227,233],[113,201,206]],"likes":47386,"tags":["pastel","cold"]}
```

`tags` is empty for palettes that are popular overall but outside the top of every theme. Palette page: `https://colorhunt.co/palette/<id>`.

## How to pick

1. Map the business type to themes (table below); let the design brief's mood override it.
2. Filter `palettes.json` by those themes, keep the top ~40 by likes, pick one seeded by the lead id so two similar businesses differ.
3. Assign roles by luminance, not by position: lightest = `bg`, darkest = `text`, most saturated of the other two = `accent`, the remaining one = `primary`.
4. If no colour is dark enough for text (contrast with `bg` under 4.5:1 — common in pastel/light themes), darken the `primary` hue to ~15% lightness for `text`.
5. Derive the rest in code: `surface` = white or bg lightened, `line` = bg darkened 8%, `muted` = text at 65%, `on-dark` = bg.
6. Buttons: text on `accent` must also pass 4.5:1; otherwise use `text` colour on it.

## Business type → themes

| Business | Themes (first is the default) |
|---|---|
| beauty_salon | pastel, skin, wedding, cream |
| hair_care | vintage, dark, gold, retro |
| nail_salon | pastel, wedding, cream, spring |
| spa | cream, nature, sea, light |
| restaurant | warm, food, fall, earth |
| cafe | coffee, cream, earth, vintage |
| bakery | cream, food, warm, pastel |
| plumber | cold, sea, sky, light |
| car_repair | dark, night, retro, neon |
| dentist | light, cold, sky, sea |
| florist | spring, nature, pastel, happy |
| gym | neon, dark, night, gradient |
| tanning | summer, sunset, warm, happy |
| daycare | kids, happy, rainbow, pastel |
| bnb / lodging | sea, nature, vintage, earth |
| landscaper | nature, earth, spring, fall |

Unknown type: `light`, `cold`.
